dz: 在第十七届托莱多公会上,希斯帕尼亚的维西哥斯王公埃吉卡指责犹太人援助穆斯林,将所有犹太人判为奴隶.
de: At the Seventeenth Council of Toledo, Egica, a king of the Visigoths of Hispania, accuses Jews of aiding Muslims, sentencing all Jews to slavery.
